title: Keep verified Evolution journal counts visible on partial reads

root_cause.summary: In GET /bff/management/evolution-journal?view=history, the BFF returned 200 OK with 6 real history rows (3 mutation_review, 3 evolution_decision), 2530 auto-proposal counts from healthy evolution_decisions and postmortems surfaces (incident_followup=433, incident_severity=9, postmortem_draft=2088), while ancillary surfaces freeze_orders and rollbacks reported status='unavailable' and management_evolution_journal reported status='degraded'. EvolutionJournalPage in src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx computed isReadFailed = Boolean(error) || (!loading && data === undefined && !isFleetSummary) || degradedSurfaces.length > 0, treating any degraded ancillary surface as a whole-page read failure and hiding evolution-auto-proposals-summary (the 2530 auto-proposal counters and evolution-view-toggle), evolution-journal-summary (including evolution-active-view-badge), and evolution-journal-pager. In addition, EvolutionJournalPage rendered summary.rollback_count (0) and summary.freeze_order_count (0) as numeric 0 even when meta.surfaces.rollbacks and meta.surfaces.freeze_orders were unavailable.

delivered: Updated EvolutionJournalPage in src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx to distinguish partial reads (where at least one journal source surface is healthy or verified rows/auto-proposal counts are returned alongside degraded ancillary surfaces) from wholly failed reads (transport error, missing data, or all journal source surfaces failed with zero rows/proposals). Wholly failed reads continue to suppress summary cards and empty-history text while showing degradedBody.

On partial reads, kept evolution-auto-proposals-summary (with all 2530 healthy-source counters and evolution-view-toggle), evolution-journal-summary (with evolution-active-view-badge, evolution-partial-read-badge, honest partial total via partialFilteredSummaryFmt, and per-source summary counts), the 6 journal rows, and evolution-journal-pager visible while preserving the evolution-journal-degraded alert and surface provenance.

Formatted per-source summary counts and auto-proposal counters in EvolutionJournalPage via formatJournalSurfaceCount so healthy surfaces render their verified counts (Decisions: 3, Mutation reviews: 3, Postmortems: 0, Auto proposals: 2530) while unavailable surfaces render honest unknown status labels ('unknown (unavailable)' / '未知 (unavailable)') instead of 0.

Added symmetric en-US and zh-TW locale keys (partialFilteredSummaryFmt, summarySourceUnknown, summarySourceUnknownFmt, partialReadBadge, partialReadBody) under mgmt.evolution in src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts.

Added component tests in src/management/pages/oversight/EvolutionJournalPage.test.tsx covering both the wholly-failed surface suppression behavior and the exact captured 00:06 partial-read payload and DOM expectations across zh-TW and en-US.
not_changing: No global shared read failure relaxation or shared BFF DTO/adapter changes.
Pantheon BFF / owner services (accepted live BFF commit 0cd59ab286b7ad4d7c742993215cb39919cce580 is unchanged).
No deployment or business write actions.
